configure.heading: Configure Popov
configure.description: Set up the database connection and security keys. Empty fields are auto-generated.

checks.heading: Server checks
checks.description: Confirming your environment is ready before creating your account.
checks.fix_to_continue: Fix the issues above to continue
checks.fix_hint: Fix the issues above in your .env file, then press "Check again".

encryption_key.label: Encryption key
encryption_key.invalid: Set, but not a valid Fernet key

jwt_secret.label: JWT secret
jwt_secret.weak: Set, but short — fine for development, use a stronger value in production
jwt_secret.default: Still the default development value — set a real secret before production

first_run.label: First run
first_run.fail: Accounts already exist — setup is already complete

admin.heading: Create admin account
admin.description: This is the first account. It automatically gets full admin access.

llm.heading: Add an AI (LLM) key
llm.description: Popov needs an LLM key to run AI investigations. You can add it now or anytime later.
llm.warning: Without a key, monitoring and ticket detection still work — only AI investigation reports will not run.

done.heading: Popov is ready
done.description: Your setup is complete and you are signed in as admin.

error.unreachable_detail: Could not reach the Popov backend. Make sure the server is running.
error.env_detail: The server started, but required environment variables are missing or invalid.
error.after_fix: After fixing your .env file, this page re-checks automatically.

mongo.title: MongoDB is not reachable
mongo.fix: Check that MongoDB is running and MONGODB_URI in your .env points to the right host.

enc_key_missing.title: DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set
enc_key_missing.fix: Add the key to your .env file. Generate one with the command below.

enc_key_invalid.title: DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY is invalid
enc_key_invalid.fix: The key is set but is not a valid Fernet key. Regenerate it — but ONLY if you have no encrypted data yet. Changing an existing key makes stored API keys unrecoverable.
